project.title: Modular Harz and Rhenish lignite district topographic relief wall panels

process.printer: Anycubic FDM printer with at least 220 x 220 mm XY build area and four-filament single-nozzle system

coordinate_frame.origin: lower-left corner of the assembled terrain-tile rear datum plane
coordinate_frame.x_axis: +X right in the installed front view
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y upward in the installed front view
coordinate_frame.z_axis: +Z from the wall toward the viewer
coordinate_frame.transform_convention: row-major 4x4 matrix maps source and component coordinates to project millimetres

requirements.statement: Each 600 x 400 mm pilot shall consist of six individually printable 200 mm-pitch tiles on the shared segmented rear-grid family.
requirements.verification: global-frame bounds, bed-fit checks, assembled seam report and physical 3 x 2 alignment test

requirements.statement: Each pilot shall preserve one immutable 16-bit global terrain master, physical aspect ratio and seam coordinates; no tile may be independently normalized.
requirements.verification: source manifests, aspect report, global scaling report and matched seam-height comparison

requirements.statement: The product family shall provide separate Harz and Rheinisches Braunkohlerevier pilots from official terrain sources.
requirements.source: user brief and approved design specification 0.2.0
requirements.verification: dataset manifests, named pilot rebuild jobs and rendered extent review

requirements.statement: Each relief shall use no more than four broad Z-based color bands in its approved abstract palette without dithering or a realistic land-cover claim.
requirements.source: approved concept v01 and palette catalog 0.2.0
requirements.verification: global layer-change manifest, exact-slicer tool/change report and physical band/purge coupon

requirements.statement: The printed product shall work unlit while reserving an 18 mm halo cavity, generic LED routes and protected true through-openings derived from terrain semantics.
requirements.source: approved design specification and concept v01
requirements.verification: keep-out collision checks, aperture geometry report, light gauge and physical illuminated coupon

requirements.statement: Each terrain tile shall be replaceable without disturbing the wall-mounted rear grid and shall survive 25 removal/reinstall cycles in the declared test.
requirements.verification: interface coupon followed by repeated tile service-cycle test

requirements.statement: LEDs, electrical parts and wall anchors are excluded and no surveying, mining-safety, structural wall-anchor or electrical-safety claim shall be made.
requirements.verification: BOM, instructions, risk register and release-package review

global_style.summary: Abstract gallery-like terrain with continuous geometry, four broad elevation colors and sparse luminous terrain traces
exclude: LED components in the sold print set
global_style.generation_material: matte Anycubic PLA palette with a neutral PETG rear grid
global_style.detail_hierarchy: whole-region relief first, seam-locked major landforms second, major contour or bench breaks third, printable local terrain last

assembly_sequence: Join and square the six shared-family REAR_GRID segments in the global 3 x 2 frame.
Install customer-selected wall anchors through the documented generic mounting slots after substrate-specific review.
Optionally install customer lighting into the halo and front-light envelopes, route the cable through one selected exit and add diffuser film if desired.
Choose one complete six-tile pilot set and place every TERRAIN_TILE_SET member on its gravity shoulder and datum pads; never mix tile positions or pilot masters.
Verify 0.25 mm target seams, terrain continuity, common color-change heights, tile retention and unobstructed intended light openings.

decision_log.topic: Approve this component, interface and manufacturing decomposition.
decision_log.current_basis: Concept v01 is approved; the guided autonomy policy assigns decomposition approval to the human owner.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Explicit approval of plan/hybrid-design-plan.json or requested corrections.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the shared magnetic tile-retention hardware and pocket compensation.
decision_log.current_basis: Recommended architecture reuses MM-ART-010 gravity shoulders and three datum pads plus four captive 6 x 2 mm magnets and steel counterparts per tile.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Exact magnet/steel part records, pull-off target, same-process pocket coupon and captive-retention test.

decision_log.topic: Freeze Copernicus GLO-30 source tiles, extent, vertical datum, licence evidence and hashes for Harz.
decision_log.current_basis: Copernicus GLO-30 is the approved official cross-state route; production download starts after decomposition approval.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable local DEM set, product metadata, acquisition/download manifest, CRS/vertical reference, hashes and attribution notice.

decision_log.topic: Freeze the current official GeoBasis NRW DGM1 tile set, acquisition state, licence evidence and hashes for the Rhenish pilot.
decision_log.current_basis: Current DGM1 is preferred because open-cast mine terrain changes materially over time.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Immutable local DGM1 set, exact extent/acquisition metadata, CRS/vertical reference, hashes and reviewed Data Licence Germany attribution.

decision_log.topic: Freeze vertical exaggeration and three global color thresholds for each pilot.
decision_log.current_basis: Relief depth is capped at 7 mm; broad global quantiles are recommended as starting thresholds, then adjusted only to preserve a documented major summit or mine-bench break.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Global elevation distributions, relief preview, threshold report, common Z heights across all six tiles and human appearance review.

decision_log.topic: Freeze actual Harz and Rhenish palette spools and transition purge matrices.
decision_log.current_basis: Retail Anycubic PLA Matte names and display colors are selected; batch identity and measured swatches are not yet available.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Spool/batch identities, physical swatches, opacity notes and exact-profile transition coupon.

decision_log.topic: Select wall-substrate-specific anchors outside the product package.
decision_log.current_basis: The printed grid will expose generic mounting slots but cannot determine the customer's wall substrate.
decision_log.evidence_needed: Actual wall substrate, chosen anchor data and installed proof test by the responsible installer.
